citations.field: 回 entry, printed p. 559; PDF p. 572; scan /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-0572/source.png
citations.text: The entry identifies 回 as pictographic and says Shang–Zhou forms resemble a revolving loop; it describes Warring States Qin forms as two enclosed rings and says later forms follow them. It proposes rotation as the original meaning, then presents turning, changing direction, changing, returning, answering, taking a circuitous route, and counting occurrences as further uses. The cited examples include 荀子《致士》“水深而回,” 楚辭《離騷》, and 杜甫《百憂集行》. These are the book’s graphic and semantic analysis and cited literary examples; the passage does not establish dates for the examples or a securely dated earliest use. I inspected the headword, paragraph, form labels, cited references, and printed page number in the scan. The entry ends on this page; page 573 continues the neighboring 國 entry, not 回.
